judgments.reason: The retained record preserves the same favorable BiSb outcome, both jointly acting pulse/current changes, and deposition conditions; reversing subject and joint factor adds no meaning.

Segment 8 explicitly links the strategy to low-grade thermal-energy harvesting through continuous i-TEC power output. This concrete proposed application can be retained as a hypothesis; r009 preserves continuous output but not that application.

Segment 5 explicitly links the absorption characteristics to proposed photovoltaic and optoelectronic uses. This application hypothesis is in scope; retained absorption properties and the separate effective-mass application claim do not preserve it.
The retained record fully preserves metal-carbon binding between MILs and SWCNTs in the same composite context.
